subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

GENTLE : VOGMVT :: FACIAL : OZRXZU :: MAKEUP : ?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 

The pattern followed in the given series is:

 **The alphabets are coded as the alphabets with opposite positional value.

 The code is arranged backwards.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/183f4a6aa8e2647216364362da7ab2096f044108e8e4109c2d2606528476ca99.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e468613bca1f60fda98a165737bd75ea86889a3328fa24618843e125c725543.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cd173f0e197cbbfcbb35febcf60d03df3f71b1428e8133bab9480037b405910.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 4)**
